name: Ratehub Mortgage
description:
Ratehub makes it easy to compare the best mortgage rates in Canada in seconds. Instantly find the lowest fixed and variable mortgage rates from the Big Banks and top mortgage lenders.

Customize your results based on home price, down payment, and location to see personalized mortgage rates you can actually qualify for. Easily compare options side by side and find the best rate for your budget.

Whether you’re a first-time home buyer, renewing your mortgage, or refinancing, this tool compares real-time mortgage rates to help save you time and money.

Try asking:
What are the lowest mortgage rates in Ontario right now?
What is the best 5-year fixed rate from top 6 banks?
Show me the best variable rate options for a $600K mortgage in B.C

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ratehub Mortgage to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ratehub Mortgage to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.ratehub.ca/claude-app/mortgages/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Ratehub Mortgage MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Ratehub Mortgage scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ratehub Mortgage MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ratehub Mortgage provides these MCP tools: get_heloc_rates, get_purchase_rates, get_refinance_rates, and get_renewal_rates.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ratehub Mortgage?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ratehub Mortgage in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Ratehub Mortgage MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ratehub Mortgage does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Ratehub Mortgage is developed by Ratehub.ca. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
